passages.original: λέγει τοῦτο Ἀρχιμήδης ἐν τῷ περὶ σφαιρικῶν.
passages.english: Archimedes says this in his [work] On Spherics.
passages.notes: "ἐν τῷ περὶ σφαιρικῶν" is rendered as a title, "On Spherics"; it may refer to Archimedes' On the Sphere and Cylinder.
